## unlockfile.hex Format Documentation {#unlockfile.hex-format-documentation .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

1\. Purpose

This document describes the structure and behavior of unlockfile.hex files, primarily used to achieve below purpose:

- No Signature check by removing the root-certificate from RC40.

- Reset downgrade protection counter

- No check for encrypted data (ASW/CB-ME/Keyfile)

2\. General Definitions and Conventions

- Endianness: All integer fields within the \`unlockfile.hex\` are encoded in Big-Endian format (Most Significant Byte first), irrespective of the target architecture.

- Deployment: \`unlockfile.hex\` files are flashed onto RCs using CB-ME.

- Authentication Requirement: Users must authenticate with a Level 1 flashing password before initiating a \`unlockfile.hex\` update.

- Address Alignment with keyfile: unlockfile.hex files utilize the same address space and addressing scheme as keyfile.hex files.

- Signature Check Requirement: If \"signature check\" has been enabled within the RC\'s security features, the unlockfile.hex must be digitally signed with a trusted key. For more info refer to [Keyfile/Unlockfile](keyfile_unlockfile.html){.topiclink}

- Software Encryption Requirement: If \"SW (Software) encryption\" is enabled on the RC, the unlockfile.hex must be provided in an encrypted format encrypted using AES128-CBC. For more info refer to [Encryption Decryption.](encryption-decryption.html){.topiclink}

+-------------------------------+------------------------+-------------+---------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Name                          | Address offset (Bytes) | Type        | Length(Bytes) | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
+===============================+========================+=============+===============+==============================================================================================================================================================================================================+
| Magic Word                    | 0                      | uint32      | 4             | Constant magic word \"UNLK\" i.e. 0x554E4C4B                                                                                                                                                                 |
|                               |                        |             |               |                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| (MAGIC)                       |                        |             |               |                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
|                               |                        |             |               |                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
|                               |                        |             |               | The RC CB-ME shall only accept unlockfiles with the correct magic word.                                                                                                                                      |
+-------------------------------+------------------------+-------------+---------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Format Version                | 4                      | uint32      | 4             | unlockfile format version for future updates.                                                                                                                                                                |
|                               |                        |             |               |                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| (VERSION)                     |                        |             |               | Constant for the version described in this document 0x00000001.                                                                                                                                              |
|                               |                        |             |               |                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
|                               |                        |             |               |                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
|                               |                        |             |               |                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
|                               |                        |             |               | The CB-ME shall only accept unlockfiles with supported format versions.                                                                                                                                      |
+-------------------------------+------------------------+-------------+---------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Hardware Type\                | 8                      | uint32      | 4             | Contains Rexroth HW-Type-Code (i.e. the same received with sys_getEcuInfo or bds_sys_getEcuInfo and written on some RC housings).                                                                            |
| (HW-TYPE)                     |                        |             |               |                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
|                               |                        |             |               | RC5-6/40 → 0x00000071                                                                                                                                                                                        |
|                               |                        |             |               |                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
|                               |                        |             |               | RC18-12/40 → 0x00000172                                                                                                                                                                                      |
|                               |                        |             |               |                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
|                               |                        |             |               | RC27-18/40 → 0x00000072                                                                                                                                                                                      |
|                               |                        |             |               |                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
|                               |                        |             |               | RC18-12E/40 → 0x00000372                                                                                                                                                                                     |
|                               |                        |             |               |                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
|                               |                        |             |               | RC27-18E/40 → 0x00000272                                                                                                                                                                                     |
|                               |                        |             |               |                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
|                               |                        |             |               | RC30-20/41 → 0x00000273                                                                                                                                                                                      |
|                               |                        |             |               |                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
|                               |                        |             |               | The CB-ME shall match the HW-Type against current hardware and only accept unlockfile if there is a match.                                                                                                   |
+-------------------------------+------------------------+-------------+---------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Production Date\              | 12                     | uint32      | 4             | Production date of the RC control unit in BCD encoding:                                                                                                                                                      |
| (DATE)                        |                        |             |               |                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
|                               |                        |             |               | YYYYMMDD (e.g. for 23rd June 2008 value would be 0x20080623 and will be written as 08-06-23 on RC housing)                                                                                                   |
|                               |                        |             |               |                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
|                               |                        |             |               |                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
|                               |                        |             |               |                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
|                               |                        |             |               | The CB-ME shall match the Production date against current hardware and only accept unlockfile if there is a match.                                                                                           |
+-------------------------------+------------------------+-------------+---------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Serial Number\                | 16                     | uint32      | 4             | Serial number of the RC control unit in BCD encoding.                                                                                                                                                        |
| (SERIAL)                      |                        |             |               |                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
|                               |                        |             |               | Example RC5-6/40: 0522 on RC housing is encoded as 0x00000522                                                                                                                                                |
|                               |                        |             |               |                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
|                               |                        |             |               | Example RC18-12/40: 0070 on RC housing is encoded as 0x00000070                                                                                                                                              |
+-------------------------------+------------------------+-------------+---------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| unlockfile Digital Signature\ | 20                     | \-          | \-            | Optional: Digital signature of unlockfile in case signature check has been enabled. Signature format is defined in chapter [Key File and Unlock File Signature Format](keyfile_unlockfile.html){.topiclink}. |
| (SIG)                         |                        |             |               |                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
